summary: Master advanced requirements engineering and stakeholder management. Learn BABOK aligned techniques to reduce scope creep and align complex projects.
lede: Requirements Gathering and Stakeholder Analysis provides a structured way to identify, validate, prioritize, and manage the needs of everyone involved in a project. This five-day course helps you connect business objectives with technical delivery while reducing scope confusion and strengthening accountability. You will practice techniques including JAD sessions, Kano Model prioritization, Requirements Traceability Matrices, Volere specifications, stakeholder mapping, MoSCoW prioritization, RACI matrices, UML, Use Case Diagrams, and User Story mapping. You will also learn to turn varied feedback into a defensible Product Backlog and manage requirements across Waterfall and DevOps workflows.
audienceIntro: This advanced program is tailored for experienced professionals who lead the interface between business needs and technical solutions in complex environments.
outcomes: Use Case and User Story Modeling
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3-5 years of experience in business analysis, project management, or systems engineering. Familiarity with the IIBA BABOK Guide or PMI PMBOK Guide is highly recommended. No coding knowledge is required, but an understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) is essential.
